message.Title: Generally Available: Playwright Workspaces in Australia East, Japan East, and Switzerland North

Body.Content:
Playwright Workspaces in Azure App Testing is now generally available in Switzerland North, Japan East, and Australia East.

Playwright Workspaces provides fully managed cloud-hosted browsers for running end-to-end Playwright tests at scale, with parallel execution, rich debugging artifacts including traces, videos, and screenshots, and seamless CI/CD integration. Customers can use their existing Playwright test suites and get started in minutes.

Learn more.
